blocks.orig: Gibb’s Farm imparts a sense of well-being, tranquillity, and history, as it is deeply rooted in African culture and community. In a warm, rustic, and luxurious environment, this peaceful sanctuary offers 17 cosy, well-appointed cottages and 2 large farmhouses perfect for families or groups. The extremely spacious cottages are all designed in a unique style, referring to either the surroundings or the history, with for example the Mulberry cottage surrounded by Mulberry trees, or the Zamani (Swahili for a long time ago) cottage as a hommage to its founders Margaret and James Gibbs. Last but not least, the breathtaking scenery, scattering wildlife, and unique cultural activities allow you to fully experience the rhythms and beauty of the farm, its community, and the surrounding nature.
blocks.html: Gibb’s Farm gives you a feeling of well-being, calm and history, thanks to its deep roots in African culture and community. In a warm, rustic and luxurious setting, this peaceful retreat has 17 cosy, well-equipped cottages and 2 large farmhouses that suit families or groups. Each of the very spacious cottages has its own style, inspired by the surroundings or by the history: the Mulberry cottage, for example, is surrounded by Mulberry trees, while the Zamani (Swahili for a long time ago) cottage pays tribute to the founders, Margaret and James Gibbs. Finally, the stunning scenery, the wildlife scattered around and the unique cultural activities let you experience the rhythm and beauty of the farm, its community and the nature around it to the full.
